correctness.rationale: For every n>=2 the graph has diameter two. Every maximal geodesic is one complete two-cell column and one other cell. Such a path has a unique complete column, giving a two-way bijection between k disjoint paths and (k columns, k distinct outside cells, bijection). This proves p(n,k)=n!/(n-k)!*C(2(n-k),k), its support k<=floor(2n/3) and the three residue-class optimal counts. The coefficient ratio R_k=(2n-3k)(2n-3k-1)(2n-3k-2)/(2(2n-2k-1)(k+1)) strictly decreases, since the key fractional ratio comparison has numerator 2n-3>0, proving strict log-concavity. A geodesic-free vertex subset either uses <=1 cell per column or is exactly one full column, yielding (1+2y)^n+n y^2; complements give T_n(z)=z^n(z+2)^n+n z^(2n-2) and every minimum/inclusion-minimal transversal. Unoriented and unordered convention explicit. Independent BFS reconstruction, recursive exhaustive packing enumerations and exhaustive vertex-subset scans for n=2..8 all passed; exact arithmetic for n=2..150 passed. Infinite claims rely on proofs, not enumeration.

originality.rationale: Literature-led theorem in the geodesic packing and geodesic transversal framework of Manuel–Brešar–Klavžar (2022 initial preprint). Its bound for diameter-two uniform-geodesic products implies the upper bound floor(2n/3), but does not imply equality, polynomial coefficients, exact optimal count, log-concavity or all transversals. Its explicit gpack formula for K_{n,n} is about the complete bipartite graph, not K_2 Cartesian K_n. Its rook-graph gt proposition concerns balanced squares K_n Cartesian K_n and gives a scalar, not the 2-by-n enumerators. Wild (2024) enumerates individual shortest paths algorithmically, not disjoint collections. Equivalent induced-P3 and full-column-to-cell matching interpretations were compared with searchable published mathematical records; no equivalent joint formulas found. Risk of unknown previous equivalent enumeration acknowledged; absence from search is not proof of absolute novelty.
residual_risks: An earlier unindexed induced-P3 packing or full-column matching enumeration could imply some or all coefficients; the searches do not certify publication priority.
Public mathematical record snippets were compared only at the claim level; no full-text noncoverage is inferred from them.
The result is specific to exactly two rows and does not establish a multirow rook-graph packing polynomial.

value.rationale: The motivating 2022 work studies a dual min-max geodesic packing/transversal framework, and explicitly calls for understanding graph products. Two complete cliques joined by a perfect matching are the smallest nontrivial Cartesian clique product, where maximal shortest paths have a rigid but nontrivial three-vertex structure. The result determines *every* path-packing cardinality and *every* hitting-set cardinality, all maximum-packing counts with a mod-three transition, strictly log-concave packing coefficients, and every inclusion-minimal hitting configuration. These are natural, previously not implied distributional and structural questions, not a single routine lower-bound consequence. It provides an exactly enumerable baseline for the harder general rook-graph packing problem and for random packing or transversal sampling. No claim of broader consequence is needed.
